sources: Natural Earth via world-atlas (naturalearthdata.com), public domain

places.name: Machu Picchu
places.blurb: A 15th-century Inca citadel high in the Andes, above the Urubamba river.

places.name: Great Wall of China
places.blurb: A chain of walls and fortifications built across northern China over many centuries.

places.name: Taj Mahal
places.blurb: A white marble mausoleum in Agra, completed in the 17th century.

places.name: Petra
places.blurb: A city carved into rose-coloured rock by the Nabataeans.

places.name: Angkor Wat
places.blurb: The largest temple of the Khmer Empire's capital region, built in the 12th century.

places.name: Pyramids of Giza
places.blurb: Royal tombs of the Old Kingdom, built more than 4,000 years ago.

places.name: Stonehenge
places.blurb: A prehistoric ring of standing stones on Salisbury Plain.

places.name: Historic Centre of Rome
places.blurb: Home of the Colosseum and the Forum, heart of the ancient Roman world.

places.name: Acropolis of Athens
places.blurb: A hilltop citadel crowned by the Parthenon, built in the 5th century BCE.

places.name: Rapa Nui (Easter Island)
places.blurb: Remote Pacific island known for its hundreds of carved stone moai figures.

places.name: Lumbini
places.blurb: Traditionally the birthplace of the Buddha, a pilgrimage site in the Terai plains.

places.name: Kathmandu Valley
places.blurb: Seven monument zones of palaces, temples and stupas in a Himalayan valley.

places.name: Bagan
places.blurb: A plain scattered with thousands of temples and pagodas from the 11th to 13th centuries.

places.name: Ancient Kyoto
places.blurb: Temples, shrines and gardens from over a thousand years as Japan's imperial capital.

places.name: Chichén Itzá
places.blurb: A Maya city whose stepped pyramid El Castillo aligns with the equinox sun.

places.name: Historic Areas of Istanbul
places.blurb: A city on two continents, shaped by Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman rule.

places.name: Timbuktu
places.blurb: A Saharan trading town long famous as a centre of Islamic learning.

places.name: Great Zimbabwe
places.blurb: Stone ruins of a medieval city that gave the country its name.

places.name: Lalibela
places.blurb: Eleven medieval churches carved down into solid rock.

places.name: Borobudur
places.blurb: The world's largest Buddhist temple, built in the 9th century on Java.

places.name: Mont-Saint-Michel
places.blurb: A fortified abbey on a tidal island, ringed by some of Europe's strongest tides.

places.name: Sydney Opera House
places.blurb: A 20th-century landmark with sail-like shells on Sydney Harbour.

places.name: Mount Everest
places.blurb: Earth's highest mountain above sea level, in the Himalaya.

places.name: Grand Canyon
places.blurb: A canyon carved by the Colorado River, exposing about two billion years of rock.

places.name: Great Barrier Reef
places.blurb: The largest coral reef system on Earth, visible from space.

places.name: Amazon Rainforest
places.blurb: The largest tropical rainforest, home to a vast share of the world's species.

places.name: Victoria Falls
places.blurb: A curtain of water over a kilometre wide, known locally as Mosi-oa-Tunya, 'the smoke that thunders'.

places.name: Iguazú Falls
places.blurb: A wide arc of waterfalls in subtropical rainforest.

places.name: Angel Falls
places.blurb: The world's tallest uninterrupted waterfall, dropping from a tabletop mountain.

places.name: Niagara Falls
places.blurb: Three waterfalls on the river linking Lake Erie and Lake Ontario.

places.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
places.blurb: Africa's highest peak, a freestanding volcanic mountain near the equator.

places.name: Mount Fuji
places.blurb: An almost symmetrical volcano and a sacred symbol of Japan.

places.name: Sahara Desert
places.blurb: The largest hot desert in the world, spanning much of North Africa.

places.name: Atacama Desert
places.blurb: One of the driest places on Earth, with some weather stations never recording rain.

places.name: Salar de Uyuni
places.blurb: The world's largest salt flat, which mirrors the sky after rain.

places.name: Lake Baikal
places.blurb: The deepest and oldest lake on Earth, holding a fifth of the world's unfrozen fresh water.

places.name: Lake Titicaca
places.blurb: A high Andean lake, among the highest large lakes you can navigate by boat.

places.name: Dead Sea
places.blurb: A salt lake whose shore is the lowest dry land on Earth.

places.name: Hạ Long Bay
places.blurb: Thousands of limestone islands and pillars rising from emerald water.

places.name: Uluru
places.blurb: A vast sandstone monolith sacred to the Anangu people.

places.name: Yellowstone
places.blurb: A supervolcano caldera with geysers, hot springs and bison herds.

places.name: Tromsø
places.blurb: A city inside the auroral zone, a classic place to watch the northern lights.

places.name: Great Blue Hole
places.blurb: A giant marine sinkhole, almost perfectly circular, off the Belize coast.

places.name: Serengeti
places.blurb: Grasslands crossed each year by one of the largest land animal migrations.

places.name: Galápagos Islands
places.blurb: Isolated volcanic islands whose wildlife helped inspire the theory of evolution.

places.name: Madagascar
places.blurb: An island home to lemurs and many other animals found nowhere else.

places.name: Borneo rainforest
places.blurb: Ancient rainforest where orangutans, clouded leopards and pygmy elephants live.

places.name: Okavango Delta
places.blurb: An inland delta that floods each year and draws elephants and other wildlife.

places.name: Monarch Butterfly Reserve
places.blurb: Mountain forests where millions of monarch butterflies spend the winter.

places.name: Komodo
places.blurb: The home of the Komodo dragon, the largest living lizard.

places.name: Svalbard
places.blurb: An Arctic archipelago where polar bears hunt on the sea ice.

places.name: Antarctica
places.blurb: A continent of ice that hosts penguins, seals and seabirds along its coast.

places.name: Mariana Trench
places.blurb: The deepest known place in the ocean, at Challenger Deep.

places.name: Point Nemo
places.blurb: The spot in the ocean farthest from any land.

places.name: Mauna Kea
places.blurb: Measured from its base on the sea floor, the tallest mountain on Earth.

places.name: Vostok Station
places.blurb: Where the lowest natural air temperature on Earth was recorded, in 1983.

places.name: Death Valley
places.blurb: One of the hottest places on Earth, a desert basin below sea level.
